body: Rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-23 04:16Z), from w-33f4 gate test-344041c2. Once a coder hands its worktree to Merger with READY and Merger gates it in that same worktree (as with wt-eval-token-11465 for BarA1's w-33f4), the coder must NEVER write there again; its follow-ups go in a separate worktree. A Claude Edit or Write leaves <file>.tmp.<pid>.<hex> during its atomic save, so the host refuses the gate's credit and the tested tree may change. Diagnosis: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process for the pid gives the claude.exe --resume id, which maps to a TermAl session through /api/state. Merger checks the gate tree against the reviewed tree after the run and relaunches only from restored, reviewed content.
